title: Iteration of the point-testing step
statement: For every block length $b\in\mathbb{N}$, bit string $u$, list $P$ of bit strings, and iteration count $i\in\mathbb{N}$, iterating the point-testing step $i$ times from the encoded state with counter consisting of $b$ ones, remaining string $u$, and stored list $P$ yields the state with the same counter, remaining string obtained by deleting the first $ib$ bits of $u$, and stored list formed by appending, for each $j<i$, the length-$b$ block beginning at position $jb$ of $u$.
